create_collection_hf: create a Hugging Face collection with a title, description, namespace, and optional private flag
create_private_collection: create a private Hugging Face collection for a specific namespace using argparse CLI
create_collection_slug_only: create a Hugging Face collection and return only the collection slug for scripting
run_collection_cli: run the hf-create-collection CLI with --name, --description, --namespace, and --private flags
review_create_collection: review the create_collection function that authenticates via HF_TOKEN and calls HfApi.create_collection
